D5/S3/Quantum/Completion/IncreasingProje.signature: theorem increasing_projection_strong_limit (S : ℕ -> Submodule 𝕜 H) [forall n, (S n).HasOrthogonalProjection] [(cumulativeSpace S).HasOrthogonalProjection] (hS : Monotone S) : (forall x, Tendsto (fun n => (S n).starProjection x) atTop (𝓝 ((cumulativeSpace S).starProjection x))) /\ (residualSpace S = ⊥ -> Tendsto (fun n => ContinuousLinearMap.toPointwiseConvergenceCLM 𝕜 (RingHom.id 𝕜) H H (S n).starProjection) atTop (𝓝 (ContinuousLinearMap.toPointwiseConvergenceCLM 𝕜 (RingHom.id 𝕜) H H (ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 H))))
